description_text_male: Testes thread like, contained within a transparent membrane.
Testes uniformly ribbon-like. Surface of testes appear smooth and uniformly textured.
description_text_female: Ovaries tapered, two distinct lobes with well developed red blood vessels. May be partially granular (some distinct ova)

description_text_male: Testes large and highly convoluted, sperm cannot be extruded. Gonads are expelled through a body wall incision.
description_text_female: Ova distinctly visible but cannot be extruded with compression. Ovaries are two large, distinct lobes. Gonads expelled through body wall incision

description_text_male: Testes milk freely or extrude sperm when compressed.
description_text_female: Ova extrude when ovaries are compressed, or ova are loose in ovaries.

description_text_male: Testes large but flaccid, watery, and bloodshot.
description_text_female: Ovaries large but flaccid and watery. May contain remnants of disintegrates ova and associated structures.
